The New Jersey facilities in this registry (Hudson County, Middlesex County, North Bergen, Secaucus) correspond to Equinix's Secaucus campus (NY2-NY6), while NY1 (the historic 165 Halsey Street carrier hotel in Newark, also tied to a Tishman operator record elsewhere in this registry) and other NY-branded buildings (NY7, NY9, NY11, and upstate NY13 in Elmsford) complete the 10-facility metro per Equinix's own site.
